name: Vigor Spike
description: Stand with eyes sighted down the shaft and weight resting evenly on two tracks of attack.

name: Spikedecree
description: Drop the axe blade along the first track at the opponent's shoulder while the second track waits.

name: Illustrious Snatch
description: Dart the spear point along the second track at the gap the first track has opened.

name: Thunderclap Spikefall
description: Sight the opponent's leading limb and hook it with the beak in a single steady pull.

name: Snatchedict
description: Rap the butt of the haft against the wrist or knee along the track the eyes have fixed.

name: Parity Crownspike
description: Read the incoming blow with a single glance and turn it away along the nearer track.

name: Haemal Heave
description: Cleave across the point where both tracks meet so the blow lands from two directions at once.

name: Prism Haft
description: Hold the gaze on one weak seam and lance the spear point into it with qi along the shaft.

name: Fearless Beak
description: Gather qi and strike down both tracks in one motion with the axe edge and the spear point together.

name: Majestic Haemal Crownspike
description: The school's closing stroke that cuts down one track and binds the foe's weapon on the other so none may answer.

name: Magnanimous Tailstop
description: Hold the halberd low and wide as if cradling a basin of still water on its haft.

name: Langetcrown
description: Cut with the axe at the edge of the opponent's reach where the basin rim begins.

name: Prism Drag
description: Prick the spear point at the hand or foot at the rim of the opponent's guard.

name: Venom Tailstop
description: Hook the opponent's gear and drain their balance away as water drains from a basin.

name: Solarsnatch
description: Sweep the axe along a low arc like a shoreline to clear those who wade in close.

name: Faithful Socketring
description: Let the haft ring against a blow and send the shock back out along the basin's curve.

name: Steeldrag
description: Run several thrusts from different angles that merge on one target like tributaries meeting.

name: Inferno Haft
description: Cleave with a surge of qi that floods through the guard and spills past the target.

name: Unbending Axeblade
description: Press the beak and haft against an opponent's weapon and hold it as still as a pool.

name: Steel Hookback
description: Raise the halberd and let the whole basin of qi fall in one axe stroke on the ground ahead.

name: Solarbeak
description: The school's doctrine stroke that sweeps the basin of the fight and presses every foe within it to the ground.

name: Bountiful Axeheel
description: Stand with the halberd along the line of an imagined river so every motion follows the current.

name: Vigordrag
description: Chop down from the bank in a clean arc that cuts across the opponent's advance.

name: Beakedict
description: Thrust straight along the bank with the spear point following the run of the river.

name: Enshrined Spike
description: Plant the haft like a bank against the current so blows slide off along it.

name: Thrall Drag
description: Catch the opponent's limb with the beak and pull it into the current of the halberd's turn.

name: Solarhaft
description: Sweep in a winding path of the axe edge that catches foes who guess the straight line.

name: Beak Pledge
description: Send a ripple along the haft to meet a blow early and carry it harmlessly outward.

name: Vacuumbeak
description: Drive the spear point low and deep along the riverbed line beneath the opponent's guard.

name: Snatchverdict
description: Cleave with the force of a spring flood behind the axe that overwhelms a guard in a single blow.

name: Spiketroth
description: Wind the haft around the opponent's weapon in a river bend and trap it against the beak.

name: Vaunted Socketring
description: Flash along the bank in a rush of qi and cut down the foe who stood at its edge.

name: Magnificent Haemal Hookpull
description: The school's flowing stroke that carries cut and thrust along one unbroken river line as long as the qi holds.

name: Solar Crownspike
description: Stand with the shaft crossing the body so two lines of attack are ready at once.

name: Vigor Heave
description: Chop across the opponent's chest from the high track to the low track in one arc.

name: Haftcrown
description: Jab the spear point diagonally across the opponent's line at the far shoulder.

name: Snatchpledge
description: Switch tracks mid-pull so that the beak hooks from an angle the foe did not guard.

name: Thrall Spikefall
description: Cross the haft over the opponent's weapon and press it down along the shared track.

name: Vigor Snatch
description: Weave across the opponent's line with two crossing steps that keep the halberd head forward.

name: Steelheave
description: Bring the axe down at the point where both tracks cross and split guard and body together.

name: Vacuumdrag
description: Lunge with the spear point where two tracks meet so the thrust cannot be parried from either side.

name: Hafttriumph
description: Cleave at the crossing and let qi press down the surrounding ground to pin those near.

name: Unrivaled Quenched Heave
description: The school's doctrine fall that brings the axe down at the crossing and holds the foe pressed beneath it.

name: Merciful Axeheel
description: Stand with the halberd high above the head like a hawk waiting on a high thermal.

name: Haemalspike
description: Drop the axe blade from the high perch onto the opponent's head or shoulder.

name: Peerless Snatch
description: Dart the spear point down from the high perch at a gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Peal Drag
description: Hook the foe and lift on the halberd's rise to pull their weight up and off their feet.

name: Inferno Beak
description: Circle the halberd overhead in a wide sweep that cuts at any who gather below.

name: Faithful Haft
description: Cast the haft across the line of a blow like a wing's shadow that turns it aside.

name: Beakbanner
description: Thrust down the steep line of a dive with the whole body behind the spear point.

name: Vaunted Langet
description: Cleave from above with qi gathered in the edge to split the guard of anyone in the basin.

name: Millstone Socketring
description: Fix the opponent's weapon with the beak and press it down under the hawk's unblinking watch.

name: Magnificent Spike
description: Flash down from the high stance in a streak of qi and cleave the chosen mark in two.

name: Illustrious Axeblade Verdict
description: The school's descent stroke that drops from the high stance onto one chosen foe and lands on the step.

name: Merciful Tailstop
description: Seat the Core and let two rivers of qi run down the arms to the halberd's head and spike.

name: Inferno Hookpull
description: Chop with qi from the first river flowing into the axe blade at the moment of impact.

name: Steellanget
description: Thrust with qi from the second river flowing to the spear point just before contact.

name: Prism Hookback
description: Hold the haft with Core qi running along it so a blow lands on the ward and not the body.

name: Unbending Langet
description: Draw the hooked opponent into the point where both rivers meet and haul them down.

name: Tempestuous Axefall
description: Fan two currents of qi out through the axe edge in a sweep that clears the near ground.

name: Parity Langet
description: Meet a blow with a current of Core qi along the haft that diverts it sideways.

name: Hookpull Edict
description: Run a spread of thrusts that fan out like river channels in a delta and seek every gap.

name: Gallant Axeblade
description: Cleave with the full drive of the Core behind the axe so that the stroke fills the basin before it.

name: Haft Seal
description: Anchor the beak in the opponent's gear with both rivers of qi so that nothing can tear it loose.

name: Vigor Spikefall
description: Bring both rivers to the Core and loose them as one stroke that cuts and pierces together.

name: Solarspike
description: The school's stroke that releases the two rivers through the halberd in a single wide cut across the front.

name: Parity Beak
description: Stand sideways to the plateau wind with the halberd laid along the sworn line.

name: Inferno Spikefall
description: Cut at the rim of the opponent's guard with the wind adding its push to the axe.

name: Prism Snatch
description: Thrust at the rim with the point held low so the gust does not turn it.

name: Entropy Hookback
description: Hook in time with a gust so that the pull and the wind together unbalance the foe.

name: Sovereign Axeheel
description: Sweep the axe low along the sworn bearing to cut the legs of those who press close.

name: Parity Socketring
description: Parry across the line of the gust so the blow is carried past with the wind's help.

name: Haftdecree
description: Run before the wind with the spear point leading and thrust as the gust peaks.

name: Noble Crownspike
description: Fall with the gale at the back and cleave through the guard in a single heavy stroke.

name: Statute Tailstop
description: Spin the halberd as a sworn windbreak that parts the blows aimed at the body.

name: Heavebanner
description: Flash across the plateau on a gust and cleave down the foe at the far end of the field.

name: Triumphant Drag
description: The school's sworn stroke that sends the plateau wind through the axe in a cut that sweeps the front.

name: Merciful Axeblade
description: Hold the halberd along a freshly taken bearing with both feet set on the same line.

name: Spike Triumph
description: Chop down exactly along the taken bearing so the blow lands where the line ends.

name: Radiance Axefall
description: Jab the spear point along the same bearing in a short thrust that does not waver.

name: Sigil Socketring
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and hold it along the bearing so it cannot leave the line.

name: Enshrined Hookback
description: Turn a blow aside by a quarter turn of the haft and return at once to the bearing.

name: Squall Heave
description: Glide along the bearing in smooth paces that keep the halberd head on the same line.

name: Sovereign Heave
description: Hold the oath through the stroke and split the guard along the exact line of the bearing.

name: Steel Snatch
description: Lance the spear point down the true bearing so that it pierces whatever stands upon it.

name: Squallbeak
description: Cut and thrust together along one bearing so that axe and point strike the same sworn line.

name: Matchless Squall Haft
description: The school's bearing stroke that cuts along the sworn line and snatches away the weapon that crosses it.

name: Bloom Beak
description: Take the first stance of the rite with the halberd laid along the line of the long gale.

name: Thunderclap Tailstop
description: Chop with the axe in the second form of the rite with one heavy blow on the gale's downbeat.

name: Spikecrown
description: Thrust the point in the third form of the rite and keep it straight with the wind at the shoulder.

name: Statute Crownspike
description: Hold the haft in the fourth form of the rite so the wind and the guard break the blow together.

name: Peal Axeheel
description: Hook with the beak as a gust strikes and pull so wind and arm together upset the foe.

name: Entropy Axefall
description: Sweep the axe in a long wind-borne arc that clears the ground in front of the body.

name: Beak Covenant
description: Parry in step with the gale so the blow is carried off along the wind's own course.

name: Valiant Langet
description: Drive the spear point forward on a gust so that the thrust lands with doubled speed.

name: Steel Axeblade
description: Cleave with the whole long gale carried in the axe so the stroke splits guard and armor.

name: Sigil Spike
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with the beak and hold it steady as a banner is held by the wind.

name: Snatchcrown
description: Loose the long gale through the axe in one stroke that sweeps and cleaves the plateau ahead.

name: Steel Hookpull
description: The school's closing rite that brings the long gale down through the axe in a stroke over the whole front.

name: Wise Spike
description: Stand with the heels at the last ground of the plateau and the halberd held level over the drop.

name: Crownspike Edict
description: Chop at the foe from the last ground to drive them back toward the edge behind them.

name: Thunderclap Axeheel
description: Thrust at the foe from the last ground so the point presses them toward the drop.

name: Langet Covenant
description: Hold the haft upright like a cliff face so blows break against it and fall away.

name: Entropy Socketring
description: Hook the foe at the edge and pull them off their footing toward the drop.

name: Drag Verdict
description: Sweep the axe along the drop line to push back any who stand upon the brink.

name: Parity Tailstop
description: Meet a blow with the haft on the updraft so the wind lifts it over the shoulder.

name: Magnificent Drag
description: Run along the edge line in a string of thrusts that leave the foe no ground to step.

name: Quenched Hookpull
description: Cleave with the full weight of a fall behind the axe so the blow lands like the drop itself.

name: Sigil Axefall
description: Snare the foe's arm or weapon with the beak and hold them at the brink.

name: Splendid Heave
description: Cleave at the brink and press down the ground with qi so those near cannot step away.

name: Peerless Haft Verdict
description: The school's final fall that brings the axe down at the brink and holds the foe pinned against the drop.

name: Bloom Hookback
description: Stand with the sworn line held against the wind and the halberd steady along it.

name: Steelspike
description: Drop the axe along the held line so the wind cannot turn the blow aside.

name: Prism Beak
description: Dart the spear point along the held line in one quick unwavering motion.

name: Peallanget
description: Hook against the push of the wind so the foe feels the pull as a double strain.

name: Devout Axeblade
description: Turn the haft against a blow and return to the sworn line without a single step lost.

name: Vigorlanget
description: Advance into a headwind in short steady paces that keep the sworn line unbroken.

name: Unrivaled Hookpull
description: Cleave straight into the wind with qi in the edge so that the blow does not slow.

name: Vacuum Spikefall
description: Lunge into the gale with the point held on the line and drive it through the guard.

name: Squallspike
description: Flash along the held line through the wind and cut the foe where the line ends.

name: Dauntless Haemal Langet
description: The school's oath stroke that cuts along the sworn line and presses the wind itself down upon the foe.

name: Vigor Axeheel
description: Seat the Core and let the sworn gale's qi run down the haft to the halberd's head.

name: Haemal Axefall
description: Chop with Core qi running into the axe blade so the cut bites with the gale's force.

name: Pulsar Drag
description: Thrust with Core qi running to the point so that it drives through at gale speed.

name: Spikepledge
description: Hook with the beak and haul the foe down on a pulse of Core qi timed to a gust.

name: Exalted Spikefall
description: Wheel the halberd in a ring of gale qi that sweeps those who press near.

name: Pall Crownspike
description: Parry along the sworn bearing with Core qi in the haft to throw the blow wide.

name: Prism Tailstop
description: Run on a streaming wind of Core qi and lance forward with a rapid string of thrusts.

name: Squalldrag
description: Cleave with the sworn gale drawn into the Core and driven through the axe in one stroke.

name: Prism Socketring
description: Hold a ward of gale qi along the haft and the Core so that blows from the front fail.

name: Quenched Haft
description: Flash upward on the gale and cleave down from the open sky with a stroke that tears the air.

name: Solarheave
description: The school's sworn stroke that releases the gale from the Core through the halberd across the whole front.

name: Vigorhaft
description: Stand with the haft slanted across the road and the weight already pressed toward the nearest foe.

name: Valiant Axeblade
description: Hew from the road verge in a long diagonal that takes the first guard across the shoulder and the collar.

name: Prismspike
description: Jab the spike along the line of the cart track at a guard who steps back into the ruts.

name: Subjugating Hookback
description: Match the stride of a guard running alongside a wagon and hook the beak behind his knee to bring him down.

name: Duneheave
description: Sweep the axe edge across the whole width of the road with qi behind it to clear those who stand in the way.

name: Squall Langet
description: Turn the haft against a blow as a cart wheel turns on its iron tire and carry the blow past the body.

name: Steel Axeheel
description: Hew with the whole body behind a qi-hardened edge to cleave through a mail shirt and the shoulder beneath.

name: Unbending Hookpull
description: Hook a foe's weapon with the beak and pin it to the road under the haft while qi holds the lock.

name: Majestic Axefall
description: Gather qi and let the axe fall in one stroke that ends the whole line of guards along the road ahead.

name: Axefall Decree
description: The school's closing stroke that clears the width of the road ahead and presses every foe left standing to the ground.
